evals.name: basic-standup
evals.prompt: Format my standup: Done - reviewed PR #42 for auth module, fixed the null pointer in user service. Next - write unit tests for payment handler. Blocked - waiting for design sign-off on the new dashboard.

assertions.name: file-exists
assertions.description: standup.md exists in the output directory

assertions.name: has-blocked-section
assertions.description: Output contains a **Blocked:** section (bold header with colon)

assertions.name: done-items-use-past-tense
assertions.description: Done section bullets start with a past-tense action verb — 'Reviewed', 'Fixed', 'Shipped', etc. — not present tense or infinitive form

evals.name: no-blockers
evals.prompt: Write my standup: Yesterday I shipped the feature flag UI and merged the cache invalidation fix. Today I'm starting the GraphQL migration. No blockers.

assertions.name: file-exists
assertions.description: standup.md exists in the output directory

assertions.name: blocked-is-na
assertions.description: The **Blocked:** section is present and contains 'N/A' — the section is never omitted even when no blockers exist
